notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27974450/bf4947e8caf83e96c51c5ed826d8e57794211a41.jpg[/img]

We told you the news that the month we passed "No70: Eye of Basir" has been postponed. As a result of this delay, we have stated that you have optimization problems. And Your good approach has made us very happy. 

We solved the optimization problems and made the game ready. We started playing the game as a team. However, due to some problems in overseas negotiations, we have to ask you to wait for 20 more days. 

Our beta tests are very positive and stable, we have solved all kinds of technical problems. While you were waiting for this process, we also published a new trailer. We look forward to June 28th and thank you very much for your support. We would like to state at least as exciting as you are. We're on Steam on June 28th.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9NobMBLj5xM&feature=youtu.be] For Trailer Link	[/url]
